She holds a silver transverse flute to her mouth, her fingers positioned on the keys. In the foreground, a translucent sheet music overlay with musical notes is visible across the bottom third of the frame. Below that, a small video inset shows a scene of a man and a woman in a dimly lit room. The background consists of a dark pier walkway with illuminated arches and distant lights. (2) The camera remains static as the woman continues to play the flute. Her facial expression is focused with her eyes partially closed, following the rhythm of her movements. Her hands move fluidly across the flute's keys. Text overlays appear at the top of the frame providing context. The lighting is bright on the subject, contrasting sharply with the deep black of the night sky and the sea behind her. (3) The woman maintains her posture, swaying slightly while playing. The sheet music overlay remains static while the video inset below her changes slightly. The background architectural elements of the pier are visible through the gaps in the railings. The scene is clean with no other moving objects or people in the direct background. (4) The woman concludes the phrase, still holding the flute in the playing position. The lighting remains consistent, highlighting the metallic texture of the instrument and the fabric of her clothing. The video ends with a brief transition or fade out.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: Filmed at: Hermosa Beach Pier, LA. "City of Stars" location. POV: YOU'RE IN LA LA LAND. FLUTE PLAYS "CITY OF STARS". [Subtitle]: City of stars. 繁星之城. (2) [Subtitle]: Are you shining just for me? 你是否只為我閃耀. (3) [Subtitle]: City of stars. 無垠星空般的城市啊. [Subtitle]: There's so much that I can't see. 有許多 我仍然無法看清. (4) [Subtitle]: Who knows? 誰能曉得呢. (5) [Subtitle]: I felt it from the first embrace I shared with you. 最初與你的擁抱 就能感覺得倒. (6) [Subtitle]: That now our dreams... 我們的夢想 如今. (7) [Subtitle]: They've finally come true. 都終歸實現. (8) [Slogan]: 人生第一次來LA... 分享給每一位夢想道路上的尋夢人! BTW能到電影場景現場 演奏喜歡的片段也是一種Dream come true呢.
